statement: Multi-kill is a construction unlocked as soon as you enter World 3 with the Death Note
To proc multi-kill you need 100% accuracy and 2x max damage of the mob's total HP
Base kill is 1 which equals 100% multi-kill; every multi-kill percent is added on top of that
Multi-kill doesn't affect experience or rare drops but increases base materials received so it's very strong for 3D printing
Multi-kill splits into additive base multi-kill and multiplicative multi-kill per tier
Base multi-kill is a flat additive; 150% plus a 30% necklace equals 180%
Per tier uses the damage tier shown at the bottom of the AFK menu; 50% per tier at x5 tier equals 250% total
Damage needed for each next tier doubles; green mushrooms with 10 HP need 20 to proc then 40 for x2 and 80 for x3
At damage tier 3 or higher multi-kill per tier is better; at three or lower base multi-kill is better
Both base multi-kill and multi-kill per tier are required late game
The wiki has almost nothing on multi-kill so the explanation relied on external help and the math gets much more complicated
Zab achievement of 125 rooms in the World 2 party dungeon gives 6% base multi-kill for all characters
OZO just passing by achievement (past 30 rooms in World 2 party dungeon) gives 2% base multi-kill
He has a World 2 party dungeon guide linked for getting those achievements
Two cute to live achievement gives 5% total multi-kill on all monsters, effectively base multi-kill
Arcade Golden Ball shop (when in rotation) gives multi-kill per tier maxing at 5% at level 100, a good multiplier
Death Note construction can be upgraded to level 51 for a max of 100 base multi-kill
Death Note itself gives multi-kill per tier for that specific world; progress doesn't carry over between worlds' Death Notes
Only one multi-kill card, Calami from World 4, gives up to 7% multi-kill per tier at four star
Mr Massacre bubble in the yellow cauldron gives huge multi-kill per tier but costs an annoying amount of salts; want it equipped for any multi-kill
Slow energy drink vial from Frozen Souls gives multi-kill and scales with the number of skulls you have
Utilitarian capsule gives printer sample percent, multi-kill per tier and cash percent; half decent
Balance of Pain prayer gives multi-kill per damage tier at cost of defense and accuracy; from Clash of Cans wave 21, no Town Hall 14 needed
Salt Lick has multi-kill percent bought with purple salts, on page two
Only one stamp gives base multi-kill; the price racks up quickly; it drops from most World 3 creatures from blokes to thermasters and from chisor
Calingo star sign gives +15 base multi-kill but better star signs exist so not suggested
Opals give base multi-kill: bronze 1%, silver 2%, gold 3% +1 weapon power, platinum 5% +1 WP, dementia 10% +2 WP
Wood chip gives 15 multi-kill per tier and multiple can be equipped on one character so it stacks as high as you want
Nuka cake fedora from the Nuka cake achievement gives 15 multi-kill
Hollow tail pendant bought in the flurbo shop gives 30 multi-kill
Keychain can roll two multi-kill stats for a max of 24 multi-kill per keychain but that roll is hard to get
Mob respawn increases kills per hour by reducing the time mobs spend dead
Mob respawn is loaded when entering a map so your gear from the previous map shows in the next map
Mob respawn maximizes base kills for rare drops; a mix of multi-kill and mob respawn goes a long way
Grim Reaper star sign gives 2% mob respawn; Grim Reaper Major gives 4% at level 60 or higher
Late-game diabolical weapons give mob respawn: gauntlets 10%, flesh reaper 8%, continuity 8%, optical 8%
Deathly cluster pendant gives 10% mob respawn; cheese orc blankie 3%; craftable upgradable chisor's caustic scarf 5%
Tier 3 keychain gives 1 weapon power, 10 defense and up to 6% mob respawn per misc stat, max 12; hard roll
For rare drop farming use drop rate and mob respawn over multi-kill because multi-kill only boosts base materials
Multi-kill is better for pushing Death Note, green spores for money percent, going through portals and 3D printer
He claims green spore T is better than plank top T, challenging viewers to change his mind
Kill per kill works both active and AFK except the Goldfish vial
Goldfish vial gives a percent chance for an extra kill, so one kill equals two
Kill per kill doesn't affect experience, drop rate or money; it only gives extra kills for portals and Death Notes
New talents like Stacked Skulls give kill per kill per 1000 agility; Squires scale with strength and mages with wisdom
Kill per kill bubble in the quick (green) cauldron gives extra kills for Death Notes and opening portals; massive when pushing portals
Kill per kill bubble is especially strong if you're in World 4 pushing portals
Killer's brightside note gives a flat 2x monster kills, which is massive
Seawater vial (the Goldfish vial) only works if you're active
